cohort: 36 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies, intractable flank pain and hydronephrosis who were treated with double J stent (DJS).
finding: Double J stent (DJS) treatment for hydronephrosis in pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of premature birth and women with hydronephrosis had a significantly higher rate of vaginal birth.
gest_age: mean 23.14 +/- 5.68 weeks at time of DJS insertion, range 12-36 weeks
